name: Gingerbread
description: A kawaii bakery: cookie-brown, icing white, candy pink and mint, with piped-icing edges and gumdrops. Ginny the gingerbread cookie runs the gift helper. Works for the holidays, birthdays or just because. Starred items are Extra Sweet.

mascot.name: Ginny
mascot.idle: Ginny, a little gingerbread cookie with icing trim, smiling
mascot.happy: Ginny, a little gingerbread cookie, beaming
mascot.sad: Ginny, a little gingerbread cookie, worried and sweating

text.title: Sweet Wishes
text.welcome: Thanks for stopping by! A gumdrop marks the ones I'd love most. Tap the {i} on a photo for sizes, colors and notes.
text.empty.title: No treats here
text.empty.text: Nothing matches those filters. Loosen one or reset them.
text.lootedNote: Someone already got this. Thank you!
text.lootCopy: This lets other gift-givers know you bought it, so nobody doubles up. {owner} won't see it.
text.planner.loading: Ginny is peeking in the oven…
text.planner.idle: Tell me your budget and I'll pick out some treats that fit!
text.planner.emptySub: {mascot} only picks from items the filters are showing.
text.planner.emptySubClaims: {mascot} only picks from items the filters are showing, and skips anything already gifted.
text.planner.none: Oh no! Nothing fits under {budget} once I save some for tax and shipping. A bigger budget, or fewer filters?
text.planner.starredFirst: Extra Sweet treats went in first.
text.planner.squeezed: Used up as much of the budget as I could!
text.planner.claimHint: Bought one? Tap "I got this!" on its card so nobody doubles up.
text.planner.undone: Undone! It's back on the shelf.
text.error.title: The bakery is closed
text.error.line: Oh no! I couldn't reach the spreadsheet. Try refreshing in a minute?
text.setup.line: The shelves are empty. Someone needs to connect a spreadsheet.
